scientific_contract.hypothesis: The implemented phase-selective stock/proxy KV consumer can execute through the pinned full Gemma target-verification path, remain exact at stock boundaries, and retain positive net target-cycle savings after all shadow maintenance costs.
scientific_contract.workload_and_quality_gates: Use the exact workload, exactness gates, cache-lifecycle gates, economic denominator, and conditional endpoint gate from the scientific binding without amendment.

readmission_evidence.repair: The prior controller omitted an HTTP readiness barrier after CUDA-graph capture. Start activation only after bounded HTTP health succeeds; connection refusal is readiness failure, not a scientific row.
readmission_evidence.bench_safety: At 02:16:31Z a strict SSH check found Docker empty, no GPU compute application, and localhost health refused. At 02:18Z authenticated provider listing matched the sole RUNNING instance and READY disk exactly to the inventory record.

bench.reuse_contract: Atomically claim the named ready bench, reuse the exact checkpoint, pinned image/source, and CUDA/compiler caches, and make no provider lifecycle mutation.

execution.first_action: Claim immediately and start one cached target-model server. Use a bounded HTTP readiness barrier through CUDA-graph completion before activation; do not add another offline gate.
execution.component: Run only the still-unconsumed full-model dual-cache component comparator and persist its typed terminal.
execution.server_replacement: One same-project cached server restart is authorized because the prior server disappeared before science and all scientific inputs remain fixed.
execution.conditional_endpoint: Run the already-bound exact-c32 stock/candidate endpoint pair only if every component exactness, cache-lifecycle, CUDA-graph, and positive-net gate passes.

budgets.compute: At most 45 claimed H200 minutes at $2.45/hour.
budgets.wall_clock: Claim by 2026-07-26T02:25:00Z and release by 2026-07-26T03:10:00Z under the verified 03:15Z cleanup watchdog.

stop_rules: Do not consume more than the one incomplete component.
Do not send activation traffic before bounded HTTP readiness succeeds.
Do not run the endpoint unless the component is exact and net-positive.
Return a typed semantic, cache, graph, or nonpositive-net result when a scientific gate fails; infrastructure failure is not a physical reject.
Stop project processes and release the bench by 2026-07-26T03:10:00Z.
Do not train, alter checkpoint values, weaken stock-boundary gates, replay completed placement evidence, or claim quality preservation or deployability.

artifact_contract.cleanup: Stop project processes and release with reusable state preserved.
